description: Get the steps to book a hotel, cruise or experience found with search_trips. Geisel Power, the Virtuoso advisor, quotes it in writing within 24 hours (rate, taxes, the hotel's cancellation policy and the perks) and books only after the traveler approves. This tool sends nothing itself (request_sent: false). Hotel bookings carry no fee and nothing is charged by Stay Perks: the traveler pays the hotel directly.
name: create_booking
